name: Three-Dimensional Tactics (Combat)
body:
Being accustomed to life underwater, many kalo warriors are trained to fight in three dimensions.

Prerequisite(s): kalo, base attack bonus +1.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are fighting underwater, in a zero-gravity environment, while flying, or in other situations where you are not restricted to a single plane of movement, you gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls in any round in which you have moved, even if it’s just a 5-foot step.
